Was told that there were other surgeries I could register with instead. Despite me already filling out the correct forms.

Then had a call from the manager. Asking if I was registered with the surgery upstairs (anyway told the last person 4 times Im currently registered in Liverpool)

The manager then told me that it's only because they don't take each others patients, fair enough. Then told me that the only reason for the call was to tell me they only had 1 doctor so my appointment times would take longer than average. I questioned why I'd had to explain 4 times in the previous call as well as that call that I wasn't registered with the GP upstairs. I was told "I'm not getting into it" and that I was basically wrong because I hadn't been asked about where I was registered on that call as that call was only about appointment times.

Not even registered and I've been lied to and given the impression they'd rather me go to a different surgery. Wouldn't recommend, they're extremely rude the way they talk to you on the phone and the manager just talks over you and won't stay quiet long enough for you to make your point (personally I think it's because she knew she'd been caught lying)

Typical NHS treatment if patients",null,[0,153]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT20xVE5teDJkVEp0TWxad09XazVkM1YyY2tsT2RWRRAB!2m1!1s0x0:0x28ec88e42a35c2ce!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOm1TNmx2dTJtMlZwOWk5d3V2cklOdVE%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT20xVE5teDJkVEp0TWxad09XazVkM1YyY2tsT2RWRRAB&t=1&&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwiMyNq52LeTAxWiMmMBHRdYN-IQoykIBCgB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwiMyNq52LeTAxWiMmMBHRdYN-IQ0pMFCAIoAA"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFBUnBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSMWswUWpoaWVGOWZSV2hFY21KNWRGYzFTSHBtVm5sTFZqVjViMEZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpSYTBOYWFtZEllSFpGV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNYOWM3LXJRRRAB",["0x0:0x28ec88e42a35c2ce",null,1729316342747859,1729316342747859,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/112044391422234569018/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Rebecca H","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjX4Nl063zRYTVOJ6BKratyCVGW0vCW0eo1Wvj3FITxDVL4GosU=s120-c-rp-mo-ba2-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/112044391422234569018?hl=en"],"112044391422234569018",null,13,1,null,[1,4,1],0,["Local Guide · 13 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwiMyNq52LeTAxWiMmMBHRdYN-IQ7LoGCAYoAA"]]]],null,"a year ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[2],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["Say there's no appointments but if you do get seen there's nobody in waiting.
